independent_review.finding: No key signature or accidental applies; these source-raster pitches supersede the mismatching OMR candidates.

source_render.coordinate_frame: source-page PNG pixel coordinates; x/y/bboxes use this frame.

transposition: Horn in F: concert pitch is a perfect fifth below written pitch. Concert spelling/octave is computed diatonically and chromatically; C4 is middle C.
clef: Treble/G clef printed at all 12 system starts. No octave-8 marking observed on this page. Audiveris bass-clef changes in local MusicXML measures 43, 58, and 87 are rejected as source-image errors.
key_signature: No key signature is printed at any of the 12 system starts. Apply only explicit or within-measure carried accidentals; natural is otherwise the source-reading default.
measure_mapping: MusicXML local measures 1–96 are pagination-local candidate labels across the 12 systems. Sparse printed bar numerals are separately recorded; no global-bar mapping is asserted.
review_method: Audiveris 5.11.0 MXL/OMR used as a candidate only. The fresh 380 dpi source-page raster was visually reviewed system by system; detected head centers were mapped to the printed treble staff geometry (middle line B4) and recomputed as written letter/octave. MusicXML candidates with false bass-clef changes in systems 8 and 12 are normalized for comparison only; source staff geometry remains authoritative. Concert transposition and fixed-do were derived from the source pitches. Confidence reflects staff-grid fit and unresolved accidental ambiguity, not an OMR pitch mismatch alone. Cue passages are flagged/excluded. Rhythm glyphs have not received a separate manual pass, so duration_quarters is null; MXL duration is retained only as a candidate.
unresolved: Source bar numerals are sparse; candidate local measure 1–96 is not a verified global measure map.
The system-1 Cor. III,V / Corno I cue boundary and system-10 Tbe. I (in C) cue endpoint are approximate; all listed cue notes remain excluded pending review.

Eight system-4 notes were independently checked at 600 dpi: n001 B3, n004 B3, n005 A4, n006 B3, n007 B3, n008 A4, n009 B3, n010 C4. No key signature or accidental applies; retain source geometry despite OMR candidate disagreements.
Systems 6, 8, and 12 have false MusicXML F-clef interpretations; the printed treble clef is used, so MusicXML pitch and duration candidates in those systems are rejected.
Durations are candidate-only and omitted from duration_quarters until a separate rhythm-glyph audit.

Five nearby altered MusicXML pitch conflicts were checked against the source notehead crops; the altered candidates belong to neighboring pitches, with no accidental glyph at the audited source heads, so they were not transferred.
45 source heads have no pitch-matched MusicXML event; their written pitch is retained from source staff geometry and the mismatch is comparison-only.
